name: CAR-T cell therapy
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Lentiviral or retroviral transduction of a chimeric antigen receptor (scFv + costimulatory domain + CD3ζ); lymphodepletion then infusion; in vivo expansion."
fields.after: "T cells are transduced with a lentiviral or retroviral chimeric antigen receptor (scFv + costimulatory domain + CD3ζ), infused after lymphodepletion, and expand in vivo."
